description: Labels the three Step 1 reconciliation cases. Synthetic billed amounts exist only here for later charge comparison tests. They are not extracted from dataset_pdfs and are not real invoice amounts.

scenarios.notes: Shipment 987654323 is printed on the national individual sample (current period, ICR 090, Claudia Musterfrau). A synthetic booking exists with the same ID and details. Billed charges stay unknown, so this is an ID/details match, not a numeric DHL amount match.

Shipment 987654325 is printed on the same sample (Petra Musterfrau, Aachen). Identity matches SYN-BK-002. Charge mismatch is demonstrated only with synthetic_billed_for_test_only versus SYN-BK-002 expected_charges. Do not fill masked PDF figures with 11.00 or 8.00.
Shipment 987654328 is printed on the national individual sample (sheet/ICR 000, current period) and has no row in bookings.json. That absence is the missing-booking case.
